_readme: Cost models. Each is built from rows in data/cost-research.seed.json and points back
at the source they came from.
Mode 'blended' means the model is one sourced all-in hourly rate rather than a
build-up of fuel, maintenance, crew and charges. That is the only mode available for
the Slovak fleet today, because 3 802 EUR/h is the only sourced direct figure that
exists. A blended rate REPLACES the components it already contains and is never added
The rate applies to the fixed-wing fleet as a whole, not to a type: the source states
it as the average of the F100 and the A319. Attributing it to one type would be an
Price year is 2020. Every flight we currently hold is from 2026, so every calculation
carries a six-year price-year gap and cannot be high confidence.
